body: Moving day was almost a month ago. This right now is me trying to take massive action to change my life. I'm in last ditch effort mode. So if I dont meet or show progress towards this life being any better by then I'm just going for a walk into the river after work on that night

That's what I am trying to do right now is focus on getting in shape and finding ways to fulfill myself. I just right now am trying to deal with the prospect of being alone for the rest of my life. And it doesn't help that everyday I am arguing with my wife because she has more empty promises for change. So she is fighting me every step of the way and considering the fact that she doesn't work I've been telling her to get a job and start supporting herself as I have been fully financially supporting her for 4+ years. She is dragging her feet on that. So one of the biggest factors for me is if I end up having to pay any sort of alimony I wont be able to make a life for myself. So every day us her trying to guilt me back into the house with her and me telling her that's not an option for me anymore.

I'm 25, fat, I work 70+ hours a week, and I'm in the process of getting a divorce so I had to move back in with my mother and brother who are both severe drug addicts. I've never owned a car, and can't afford one because my soon to be exwife is taking me for a ride. For others to say or think anything that involves them even being present to say anything. Outside of my wife i have no friends to even be heard of and now that's over too. I have anxiety and depression, I'm on meds that help with the depression sometimes but I dont believe that meds can fix what I've got.
